decision: Continued the existing branch because the task depends on its uncommitted demo implementation. No stash, reset, clean, merge, commit or push.
demo_audit: Existing finite trail, shift_interval/shift_cells, actual supply counters and synchronized capture worked. Saved 200-update seed-303 demo has matched nominal budgets and no visible occupancy tracking; old artifacts reused read-only.
fixed_parameters: Seed 303, 48x48, 200 updates, 4 lanes, width 4, reserve 20 with goal_boost 2, injection 0.04, spawn spread, infra_decay 0.01, defense 0, radiation 50, cleanup 1000, population cap 1000.
existing_adapter: scripts/coralai_search.py is supervised-only and belongs to #26. It and its config remain unchanged. New main_opt temporal dispatch reuses its bounded decode utility, the shared ClipScorer, evosax.Sep_CMA_ES and the existing ASAL metric.
renderers: Headless original RGB uses per-frame min/max energy, infrastructure and raw genome IDs. substrates/coralai default RGB has fixed resource scales and occupancy blue. Both expose energy. New scoring view is explicitly an occupancy-only adaptation: white genome>=0, black empty; no resource or genome identity input.
temporal_objective: Unchanged calc_open_endedness_score; each sampled embedding compared with every earlier one. Zero first row and zero floor from the implemented triangular mask retained. Scores are not adjacent-frame pixel differences.
schema: Dedicated coralai_temporal_search schema validates the temporal adapter, nested shift-only mapping, model, seed and sampled updates. Legacy supervised pilot schema/defaults unchanged.
plan_executed: Set up separate persistent pinned CPU runtime and test exact objective/input invariance.
Time 40 updates/two CLIP frames, then run 4 proposals x 2 generations on one seed.
Reuse fixed/hand references, run frozen-occupancy moving-energy control, check budgets/synchronization, save finite comparison.
interpretation: No candidate beat the hand setting by more than 1e-7; baseline retained. Resources shift; occupied masks also change over time, but all changes occur in sampled windows containing scheduled killing/radiation (updates 1,51,101,151). Fixed vs hand differ by one occupied cell at the end. This does not demonstrate resource tracking, movement, reproductive viability or greater ecological complexity.
limitations: Single seed and eight proposals (seven unique); no generalization or indefinitely open-ended claim.
Binary occupancy is an explicit scoring adaptation and discards organism identity/infra; a foundation-model score is not ecological validation.
Scheduled disturbances create most temporal occupancy novelty; search did not add improvement.
Fresh runs only: trail reserve is not restored by checkpoint resume. CPU arithmetic may vary slightly across runs.
